description:
This sound was recorded by me personally.

Original field recording of an intense forest mountain stream (brook) in the taiga of the Russian Far East.

Recorded on June 1st during a sunny day. The water flows vigorously over rocks and boulders, creating a rich, powerful sound.

Recorded with Zoom H4n (XY stereo) without wind protection. Light noise reduction was applied afterwards to reduce wind rumble.  
Technical: 16-bit / 41 kHz
name: Forest Mountain Stream - Intense Flow in the Far East Taiga
